business: The Aldera, magnesium bisglycinate in daily sachets
target: US adults 25 to 45, mostly women, who buy supplements on TikTok Shop after watching wellness and sleep videos

behaviours.name: Impulse buyer from TikTok videos
behaviours.how: Buys from the yellow cart when a creator's video hits a problem she has.

behaviours.name: Already loyal to a competitor
behaviours.how: Already takes Toplux or Goli and reorders when it runs out.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Waits for flash sales and coupons, compares price per day.

behaviours.name: Reads every review and label
behaviours.how: Checks reviews, dose and third-party testing before buying.

behaviours.name: On-the-go routine person
behaviours.how: Carries everything in a bag, forgets pills at home, travels often.

behaviours.name: Skeptic of supplements
behaviours.how: Thinks most supplements are a waste unless a doctor recommends it.

behaviours.name: Gummy-only
behaviours.how: Hates swallowing pills, buys gummies or drinks.

objections: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer
